title: int:BatteryUnit
description: Battery energy storage system (BESS). Subclass of int:Asset, cim:BatteryUnit, IEC 61850 ZBAT. Static parameters defined here; dynamic measurements and state expressed as sosa:Observation instances.

pInBatMax.description: Maximum charge power rating in watts. IRI: cim:maxChargePower. Unit: W. Must be > 0 and <= nominalPower.

pOutBatMax.description: Maximum discharge power rating in watts. IRI: cim:maxDischargePower. Unit: W. Must be > 0 and <= nominalPower.

ratedE.description: Nominal energy storage capacity in kWh (manufacturer datasheet). IRI: cim:ratedE. Unit: kWh.

batteryTechnology.description: Battery cell chemistry or technology type. IRI: int:batteryTechnology.

socMin.description: Minimum allowable state of charge as a percentage (0-100). IRI: int:minStateOfCharge. Must be < socMax.

socMax.description: Maximum allowable state of charge as a percentage (0-100). IRI: int:maxStateOfCharge. Must be > socMin.
